title: Nonempty Selected Coordinates
statement: Let $T$ be a conjunction of literals with pairwise distinct variable coordinates, and let $P$ be a set of positions in its list of literals. The list of coordinates selected at positions in $P$ is nonempty if and only if $P$ is nonempty.
hypotheses_covered: A DNF term with pairwise distinct literal indices
